summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated in-tree payload
details: The package declares a preinstall lifecycle hook ("node setup.mjs") that runs an obfuscated wrapper. setup.mjs is written with obfuscator.io-style hex-mangled identifiers (_0x488df8, _0x52943e, _0x3161c8) and downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, extracts and chmod+x's the Bun binary, then execFileSync's Bun against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line JS file bearing obfuscator.io fingerprints (rotating string array via WV8StW, hex-encoded identifier names, indexed constant table hc1jfK9) with no readable code and no relation to the package's declared purpose of providing an ESLint Babel configuration. The pattern — fetch an alternate JS runtime specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated blob on npm install, with the lifecycle wrapper itself obfuscated to hide the fetch-and-execute logic — is an alternate-runtime dropper that runs unreviewed code on the installer's machine during a normal npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
